answer: An identity earns its seat through Endorsed debt counsellor session file with debt counsellors confirmation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 89 POA of exposure, so 729 aliases carry 64881 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One river of signal, one sable of cost, one quill of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
